purpose: Moves knowingly shipped without a presentation binding. CI fails on any unbound move NOT listed here, so this file is a shrinking debt list, never a place to silence new gaps.
removal_rule: Delete the entry in the same PR that adds the move's presentation binding. Never add an entry to make CI green without an owner and a reason.
runtime_consequence: An unbound move resolves to PresentationAnimationIds.ATTACK_FALLBACK ('attack'). No character package builds an 'attack' animation, so ProductionFighterVisual._generic_fallback substitutes 'stand_light' and the move plays the light-attack animation behind a single push_warning. It looks plausible and is wrong, which is harder to notice than a blank frame.
